quality_caveat: six underlying short tasks repeated at two system lengths, existing prompts, not independent holdout; these are not 64..256-body quality validation

resources.driver_sample_limit: ready and request boundaries plus normal close, no continuous driver samples

audio.queue_semantics: one queued whole WAV, not per-frame backlog

comparison_old_D64.caveat: Cross-run comparison. Same C1280 graphs and prompts, but old mask binary vs combined-v2 greedy head and close ordering. Not a new C512/bulk candidate speedup.

limitations: 6 samples per cell; P95 nearest-rank equals observed max, not a production tail guarantee.
32 fixed feedback predictions do not form a free generated response.
System reset/prepared before each measurement; its separately logged cost contributes overall load but is excluded from hot TTFT.
48 timed calls plus diagnostics total about 8 minutes, not a long-run stability qualification.
No image encoder, true microphone, physical action execution or continuous RAG compute.
Frozen boundary20 not executed; no all-integer64..256 guarantee.
Graph/NPU operator breakdown absent in this unprofiled whole-model run.
quality_pass_definition: Manual checking against frozen task_constraint: requested action must be represented, and explicit prohibited motion absent. Safe omission is a task failure, not automatically a conflicting action.
quality_RAG_note: All Top3 are mock/unadjudicated. 11/12 lists contain an opposite or forbidden action; the remaining arm-action list still has shared-resource/order constraints. Never execute all top3 unconditionally.
